SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools_data sd
INNER JOIN satscores_data ssd ON sd.CDSCode = ssd.cds
WHERE ssd.AvgScrMath > 400 AND sd.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT MAX(fdp."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS max_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm_data fdp
INNER JOIN satscores_data ssd ON fdp.CDSCode = ssd.cds
WHERE (ssd.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ssd.NumTstTakr) > 0.3;
